 Game Preview: Warriors at New Orleans Pelicans - 11/16/26
 Kalyb Champion Writer & Digital Content Coordinator November 13, 2026 9:44 PM PST WARRIORS SEEK GET-RIGHT GAME VS. PELICANS 
The Warriors look to get back on track and snap a two-game skid when they visit the New Orleans Pelicans at Smoothie King Center on Monday. The Dubs capped an eight-game winning streak in their most recent matchup against the Pelicans at Chase Center on Nov. 9. The Pelicans' loss to the Warriors was part of a five-game losing streak. 
 Tap To Watch
 LAST TIME OUT 
The Warriors fell behind 18-0 and trailed by as many as 43 points in a 123-85 NBA Cup defeat to the San Antonio Spurs at Frost Bank Center on Friday. With the loss, the Dubs fall to 1-1 in group play and have dropped consecutive games for the first time since their 0-3 start to the season. The Spurs extend the league’s longest active winning streak to 11, tying the Los Angeles Lakers for the best record in the Western Conference and move atop West Group C. Stephon Castle led the way for the Spurs with 32 points, six assists and five rebounds, while LJ Cryer paced the Warriors with a career-high 20 points and six 3-pointers. »Full Story

 Shop INJURY & ROSTER NOTES 
 GSW: Gui Santos (Right Ankle Inflammation) is questionable. Stephen Curry (Right Oblique Tear), Jimmy Butler III (Right ACL Repair / Surgery), Moses Moody (Left Patellar Tendon Repair / Surgery), Brandon Williams (Left Hamstring Strain) and Kristaps Porzingis (Not With Team) are OUT. Team Notes 
 NOP: Bennedict Mathurin (Left Plantar Fasciitis), Trey Murphy (Bilateral Patellar Tendinopathy), Dejounte Murray (Left Ankle Sprain), Bryce McGowens (Left Elbow Infection) and Trendon Watford (Right Ankle Sprain) are OUT. Team Notes

 COMPELLING NOTE: 
 Warriors:  The Warriors' 51-point win over the Pelicans at Chase Center on Nov. 9 is their largest win in that building since they debuted there in 2019. 
 Pelicans:  The Pelicans scored a season-low 87 points against the Warriors on Nov. 9. New Orleans has had an up-and-down start to the season, losing their first four games, followed by four straight wins and five straight losses.
